title: Scenario Matching for Credit Dependence Stress Tests: Temporal correlation constraints and empirical risk bounds
abstract: arXiv:2610.35118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We couple two sets of simulated market and credit paths by minimizing absolute temporal-correlation error relative to a prescribed target. Each market path receives exactly one credit path, preserving both empirical distributions of complete scenarios. A perfect-matching test identifies whether a uniform correlation-error tolerance is feasible and determines its smallest attainable value. Further assignments give exact empirical mean-loss and exceedance-probability bounds; quantile bounds follow by binary search over eligible loss thresholds. A synthetic bond-forward credit stress test illustrates the method. The experiments report matching precision, empirical score tails and exposure-grid error, and measure matching and mean-loss computation. translated_title: 信用依赖性压力测试的情景匹配：时间相关性约束与经验风险界
translated_abstract: 我们通过最小化相对于预定目标的绝对时间相关误差，将两组模拟的市场路径和信用路径耦合起来。每条市场路径恰好分配一条信用路径，从而保留完整情景的经验分布。完美匹配检验用于判断统一的相关误差容忍度是否可行，并确定其可达到的最小值。进一步的分配给出精确的经验平均损失和超越概率界；分位数界则通过在合格的损失阈值上进行二分搜索得到。一个合成的债券远期信用压力测试示例说明了该方法。实验报告了匹配精度、经验得分尾部和敞口网格误差，并测量了匹配和平均损失计算的耗时。该方法独立于情景生成器，为检验现有风险引擎中的依赖性假设提供了一种可复现的方式。尾部度量涉及以违约概率加权的（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过最小化时间相关误差将市场路径与信用路径进行完美匹配的方法，在保留经验分布的同时为信用依赖性压力测试提供精确的经验平均损失和超越概率风险界，且独立于情景生成器、可复现地检验现有风险引擎中的依赖性假设。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a perfect-matching method that pairs market and credit scenario paths by minimizing temporal-correlation error, providing exact empirical mean-loss and exceedance-probability bounds for credit dependence stress tests while preserving empirical distributions and offering a reproducible, generator-independent way to examine dependence assumptions in existing risk engines.
